summary: Body of 18-year-old Nicholas L. Hellbusch of Lenexa, KS found below The Ledges on the Longs Peak Keyhole Route approach; spotted ~7 a.m. Fri Jul 25 by a climber heading up the route; rangers reached the body 10:15 a.m. and confirmed him deceased; US Forest Service Northern Colorado helicopter assisted recovery; body flown to Upper Beaver Meadows helipad and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner; no foul play suspected.
location: Longs Peak, below The Ledges, Keyhole Route
notes: Identity confirmed by Boulder County Coroner; occurrence date set to discovery date per DB convention (body-found incidents); reported in NPT's Jul 2014 Creadon rescue coverage the same day. Run 570: romo.htm compendium URL appended (parent-opened this run); corroborates the body-below-The-Ledges finding.
